paragraphs.text:
“No!” Charlie bares her teeth. “The white man never understands! 
To speak of the Great Wind-Walker is to summon it near! We must 
flee the North Hanninah!”

To leave Bernard and this mystery, go to 32. To demand that Charlie 
forget her superstitions and help the rest of you search, go to 521.
